What do you need from us?
3–5 photos of each friend (face, full body, a typical outfit), photos or pins of your places, and the stories. Every person in the game signs a short consent form.
What do we play it on?
Any laptop or desktop browser, nothing to install. It's played with a keyboard; phones show a short “open this on a laptop” card.
Yes. You approve the faces first, then play a preview. Side Quest includes one round of changes, Squad Trip two, Saga three.
They're only used to make your game, and deleted 60 days after delivery. We never use photos of children, celebrities or brands.
Yes. Each friend gets their own payment link, and we start once the organiser's share and half the total are in.
Is the art made with AI?
We use AI tools to help draw characters from your photos, then check and fix every image by hand. Nothing is published without your approval.
